timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 55-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.56, creatinine 0.94, hemoglobin 13.1, pao2 55, platelets 230, sodium 140, wbc 7.6; vitals dbp 65-69, heart_rate 78-83, map 86-87, o2_flow 0-5, resp_rate 28-31, sbp 122-129, spo2 88-94, temp 36.8-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Oxygen via nasal cannula 5 L/min
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.96, hemoglobin 13.2, platelets 231, sodium 141, wbc 7.6; vitals dbp 66-69, heart_rate 79-83, map 85-87, o2_flow 5, resp_rate 21-26, sbp 121-128, spo2 93-95, temp 36.8-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 55-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
